artboards.title: Reply alert on Home — why & proposal
A · 'New reply' strip under the One Thing (recommended)
B · A fresh reply takes the One Thing slot

annotations.text: WHY IT WAS BURIED — Home already builds a reply card (homeTriage.ts replyItem), but the ladder is resume > crisis > overdue > reply. Any overdue plan action — here, IHSS, 43 days — outranks every reply, so a reply that came in this morning never surfaces. Only one card shows at a time.
